$schema_comment: ODP-OSS-DECISION-PACK-001 case matrix: D01-D14 cross-referenced with real lockfile versions and first-party ownership. This is an evidence document, not a decision or approval.

cases.title: LGPL libvips via sharp (image optimisation)
cases.landing: Retain existing functionality; verify actual binary, linking method, and applicable upstream obligations. Allow does not mean exempt from obligations.
obligations_to_verify: Source code offer for libvips (upstream source already publicly available)
User relinking capability (shared library, not statically linked)

cases.title: LGPL psycopg2 with linking exception
cases.landing: Receipt binds to actual version and exception text; confirm current dependency still includes this version.
cases.linking_method: C extension loaded via Python import; upstream LGPL + explicit linking exception
cases.exception_text_reference: psycopg2 LICENSE file: LGPL with linking exception permitting use as a library without copyleft propagation
obligations_to_verify: Confirm exception text present in installed version 2.9.12

cases.title: LGPL psycopg 3.x (no linking exception)
cases.landing: Handle per selected conditions: dynamic linking, NOTICE, source offer, relinking. Do not inherit psycopg2's exception.
cases.linking_method: C extension (psycopg-binary) dynamically loaded; pool is pure Python
obligations_to_verify: Dynamic linking / unmodified upstream binary distribution
Source code offer for psycopg C extension
No inheritance from psycopg2 linking exception — different license terms

cases.title: LGPL moocore (multi-objective optimisation core)
cases.landing: Dynamic loading, use unmodified upstream binary, retain NOTICE; verify actual distribution form for other obligations.
cases.linking_method: Compiled C/C++ extension module dynamically imported by pymoo
obligations_to_verify: Dynamic loading / shared library semantics under LGPL-2.1
Source availability (upstream on PyPI with sdist)

cases.title: First-party workspace packages — mark UNLICENSED
cases.landing: Only apply to packages with provable first-party identity; do not batch-approve third-party UNKNOWN packages.
cases.first_party_evidence: All 8 packages are defined in root package.json workspaces array (apps/web, packages/*), scoped under @oday-plus/*, and have no license field set. They are not published to any public registry.
obligations_to_verify: Confirm all 8 packages still exist in workspace at delivery time
Confirm no package.json has been removed or renamed
Ensure UNLICENSED marker does not affect product delivery or customer service

cases.title: Dev toolchain vulnerability — TEMPORARY_ACCEPT direction
cases.user_choice: TEMPORARY_ACCEPT, limited to internal dev scope
cases.landing: Policy direction only. Fresh un-suppressed audit shows 0 vulnerabilities (pip-audit: 0 vulns across 215 deps; npm audit: 0 vulns across 567 deps). Per Execution Plan §2.2, since there are no active findings, no waiver/exception is needed or created.

audit_result.prior_count_2026_08_08: 13 high in dev toolchain (stale; fully remediated)

cases.receipt_status: no exception needed — zero active findings in un-suppressed audit
